notes: CaixaBank (CaixaBankNow) gives movements as Excel, no CSV for personal accounts. The real download is an old binary .xls; written as .xlsx with the same cells. Row 1 "Movimientos de la cuenta <IBAN>", row 2 "Importes expresados en euros" (KashaFlow puts it over the Importe column; IGP-2.0 in column A), header row 3: Fecha | Fecha valor | Movimiento | Más datos | Importe | Saldo. Dates TEXT dd/mm/yyyy (most widely reported; some parsers also accept date cells), signed numeric Importe, running Saldo, newest first. The counterparty is in Movimiento or in Más datos, so a reading should join both. A wider 23-column "full detail" export (F. Operación, F. Valor, Ingreso (+), Gasto (-), Concepto complementario 1-10) also exists and is not this file. Currency taken from "Importes expresados en euros".
